body: Every night the keeper climbed the ninety-nine steps to trim the wick. The lamp threw a long arm of light across the water, and the ships answered with their horns.
Fog rolled in before dawn and swallowed the masts one by one. By breakfast the whole harbour was a grey room with no walls.
Le café ouvrait à six heures. Les habitués arrivaient avec leurs journaux, saluaient la patronne et commandaient le même petit déjeuner depuis vingt ans.
灯台守は毎晩九十九段の階段を上り、灯心を整えた。光は水面を長く横切り、船は汽笛で答えた。
The parade ended with 🎉 and 🎆 over the square — nobody wanted to go home. Great job, everyone! 🎊
